context: One of the most thrilling 30 lap features, one to be proud of,
was won by Bill Johnson on his hometown track, the Slinger
Speedway in Slinger, Wisconsin, last Sunday night. Bill Schwis-
ter, Milwaukee, in his fiery Thunderbird powered Ford held
the lead until the 27th lap when Johnson's Corvette powered
Ford stole past to pick up the checkered flag in record time (52.97
mph). The old track record (52.70 mph) was held by Etchie
Biertzer, Barton, Wisconsin, who placed third directly behind
Schwister. Miles Melius, Slinger, and Carl Kulow, Plymouth,
Wisconsin, made last ditch stands to improve their standings but
had to settle for 4th and 5th respectively.
